title: Navigation in Themes: Render Menus, Breadcrumbs and Pagers | Orchard Core
description:
A theme decides how an Orchard Core site draws its menus, breadcrumb trails and pagers. The shapes behind them, and the names of their templates, are not obvious from the admin.

This video renders a menu by its alias, declares a breadcrumb trail with the tag helper, and creates a pager in a controller. It then shows the templates and alternates that draw each of them, so a theme can override them.

In this video:
• Navigation shapes: templates and alternates
• Rendering a menu with the menu tag helper and the shape tag
• Menu, MenuItem and MenuItemLink templates
• Breadcrumbs: trails, providers and templates
• Pagers: page links, slim pagers and page sizes
